name: toolbox
description: A side pane listing everything you can use in Claude Code: slash commands, skills, mods, hooks and workflows, with what you use most at the top, plus your ideas and drafts.

workshopDir.title: Workshop folder
workshopDir.description: Where your ideas (IDEAS.md) and drafts (mods/, skills/, hooks/, workflows/) live. Empty: CLAUDE_WORKSHOP_DIR, else ~/claude-workshop, created on first use.

launcher.title: Launcher icon
launcher.description: on: a ⚒ above the prompt opens the Toolbox. off: open it with /toolbox.

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: on: the Toolbox opens when a session starts. off: it stays closed until you run /toolbox.
